sections.label: Main Estimates expenditure heads
sections.summary: The Main Estimates consist of Heads B, C, D, E, F, G and Z, which are proposed to be taken en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: In respect of the Main Estimates, they are Heads B, C, D, E, F, G and Z.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I propose to take those heads of expenditure en bloc.
